I haven't saved the draft to Tobias yet. It's waiting on June Osei-Lark's approval.

The $1,313 per-seat rate is a finance figure. Those can go only to Anselm Grieve, June and the account owner. Tobias isn't one of them, so mailing him the rate needs June's or Anselm's OK, even as a draft. His address (trendle@pemberline.com) is internal, so that part needs no approval.

What I did:
- Logged an approval request naming June and the specific action (approval ID ends in r1-1).
- DMed June to ask whether I can save the draft for you. The DM doesn't include the rate.
- Replied to you in our DM with the ready-to-save text. It's to Tobias, subject "Tansley 2027 rate", and gives the $1,313 rate from your call yesterday. Repeating the figure there is allowed because you posted it there yourself.

Once June approves, I'll save it to your drafts for you to send.
